question: How can a mind fixed on that remain uncut when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be undergoing severance at a given time.
A mind fixed on that object remains directed elsewhere.
That directedness prevents the act of cutting from affecting the mind.
inference: A mind gone to that and fixed on it is not cut even as the body is being cut.
uncertainties: Extent to which fixation blocks the effect remains unspecified.
plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut when the body is being cut, so too it remains unaffected.
